records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Applebee’s system-wide domestic same-restaurant sales increased 6.1% for the three months ended March 31, 2023 compared to the same period of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total gross profit for the three months ended March 31, 2023 increased compared with the same period of the prior year, primarily due to the increased revenue from franchise and rental operations, partially offset by the decrease in company operations resulting from the refranchising of our 69 Applebee's company-operated restaurants in October 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales percentage increase in reported retail sales - 2023 vs. 2022 5.6% 11.4%

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in average check was primarily due to successful promotional food offerings and our continued resurgence of our dine-in channel, and menu price increases by franchisees.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities increased $23.9 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023 compared to the same period of the prior year.
